refuted.fact: F44 verbatim_quote: 'CUDA-Q also provides an open, extensible logical layer for fault-tolerant workloads, Quantum Error Correction (QEC) codes and QPU architecture co-design, currently in preview.'
refuted.why: Not verbatim. The live page reads '...logical layer for fault-tolerant fault-tolerant\nworkloads, ...' — NVIDIA's docs contain a duplicated 'fault-tolerant'. I checked the raw HTML, not just extracted text, so this is not an extraction artifact. A silently cleaned-up verbatim_quote is exactly what a translator copies.
